QuestInfo.name: [Guild Castle] Rebirth and Rebuilding
QuestInfo.1: Benedict's asked you to visit the castle.
QuestInfo.2:
Benedict offered you the position of #bcastellan#k. He said he wants to find out the truth of the Energy Stone's power. You gladly accepted his offer, and #byour guild now has a new home#k.

It's quite a place you've come to. There's much to learn, and much work to do. Are you up for the responsibility?
